purpose: One still per opening statement (Agents, Worlds, Memory and skills); labels, rings and cards are HTML/SVG overlays in index.html, placed from projected 3D points.

twin: MuJoCo Menagerie unitree_g1 (commit b0655057a9df) with the 29 recorded joint angles (observation.state, radians); base placed by stance-foot odometry so the supporting foot stays fixed on the floor
staged: broom and dustpan follow the recorded hand positions; room, bucket and debris are a staged set

stills.composite: the last frame solid; earlier frames blended in where they differ from the static room, fading with age
